name.en: Micha the Symbol of the Angels
name.ja: <ruby>天<rt>てん</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt>し</rt></ruby>の<ruby>印<rt>しるし</rt></ruby>ミカ

requirement.en: There are 2 or more different Types among the face-up monsters on the field during a turn you have not activated "Micha the Symbol of the Angels".

effect.en: Draw 1 card. Then, if you have "Lufer the Symbol of the Devils" in your Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 Level 4 monster from your opponent's Graveyard face-up to your field.
